description.zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
description.en: The personal access token. This parameter is optional when you authenticate by using an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or temporary STS credentials.
The end time for filtering commits.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The organization ID. You can get this ID from your Alibaba Cloud DevOps organization URL, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

description.zh:
页码 
默认值为1，从第1页开始
description.en: The page number of the page to return. The default value is `1`.

description.zh:
每页大小
默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
description.en: The number of results to return on each page. The default value is `20`. The value must be an integer from 1 to 100.

description.zh: 代码仓库内的文件路径，获取该路径下的文件目录，默认获取代码库文件树的全部结构
description.en: The path of a file in the repository. If you specify this parameter, the operation returns only the commits that affect this path. If you do not specify this parameter, the operation returns the commits of the entire repository.

description.zh: 分支名称、标签名称或CommitID，默认为代码库库默认分支
description.en: The branch name, tag name, or commit ID. If this parameter is not specified, the system uses the default branch of the repository.
The keyword to use for the search in commits.

description.zh:
展示评论数量
默认值：false
description.en: Specifies whether to include the number of comments in the response. The default value is `false`.
Specifies whether to include the signature in the response. The default value is `false`.
The start time for filtering commits.

title.en: Query the commit list of a code repository
